items.source: fromAction - the action binding expression that was evaluated to retrieve the specified outcome, or null if the outcome was acquired by some other means
items.translation: fromAction - 用于检索指定结果的已评估操作绑定表达式，或者如果结果是通过其他方式获取的则为 null。

items.source: outcome - the logical outcome returned by a previous invoked application action (which may be null)
items.translation: outcome - 由先前调用的应用程序操作返回的逻辑结果（可能为 null）

items.source: originalNavigationHandler - the original NavigationHandler, or null if none
items.translation: originalNavigationHandler - 原始的 NavigationHandler，或者如果没有则为 null

items.source: Supports the standard JSF style of decoration (through a constructor argument) as well as an overloaded handleNavigation method with explicit NavigationHandler argument (passing in the original NavigationHandler). Subclasses are forced to implement this overloaded handleNavigation method. Standard JSF invocations will automatically delegate to the overloaded method, with the constructor-injected NavigationHandler as argument.
items.translation: 支持通过构造函数参数使用标准的 JSF 装饰风格，以及一个带有显式 NavigationHandler 参数的重载 `handleNavigation` 方法（传入原始的 NavigationHandler）。子类必须实现这个重载的 `handleNavigation` 方法。标准的 JSF 调用将自动委托到该重载方法，并将构造函数注入的 NavigationHandler 作为参数传递。

items.source: Implementations should invoke callNextHandlerInChain to delegate to the next handler in the chain. This will always call the most appropriate next handler (see callNextHandlerInChain javadoc). Alternatively, the decorated NavigationHandler or the passed-in original NavigationHandler can also be called directly; however, this is not as flexible in terms of reacting to potential positions in the chain.
items.translation: 实现应调用callNextHandlerInChain以委托给链中的下一个处理器。这将始终调用最合适的下一个处理器（参见callNextHandlerInChain的 Javadoc）。或者，也可以直接调用装饰后的 NavigationHandler 或传入的原始 NavigationHandler；然而，这在应对链中潜在位置方面不够灵活。

items.source:
Will call the decorated NavigationHandler specified as constructor
argument, if any. In case of a DecoratingNavigationHandler as target, the
original NavigationHandler as passed into this method will be passed on to
the next element in the chain: This ensures propagation of the original
handler that the last element in the handler chain might delegate back to.
In case of a standard NavigationHandler as target, the original handler
will simply not get passed on; no delegating back to the original is
possible further down the chain in that scenario.
items.translation: 如果有装饰的构造函数参数指定的 NavigationHandler，将调用该装饰器。如果目标是 DecoratingNavigationHandler，则通过此方法传入的原始 NavigationHandler 将被传递给链中的下一个元素：这确保了原始 Handler 的传播，以便处理程序链中的最后一个元素可能委托回它。如果目标是标准 NavigationHandler，则原始 Handler 将不会被传递；在这种情况下，链中后续无法再委托回原始 Handler。

items.source:
If no decorated NavigationHandler specified as constructor argument,
this instance is the last element in the chain. Hence, this method will
call the original NavigationHandler as passed into this method. If no
original NavigationHandler has been passed in (for example if this
instance is the last element in a chain with standard NavigationHandlers
as earlier elements), this method corresponds to a no-op.
items.translation: 如果没有在构造函数中指定装饰的 NavigationHandler，则此实例是链中的最后一个元素。因此，此方法将调用传入此方法的原始 NavigationHandler。如果未传入任何原始 NavigationHandler（例如，如果此实例是包含标准 NavigationHandler 作为早期元素的链中的最后一个元素），则此方法对应于一个空操作。

items.source: This implementation of the standard JSF handleNavigation method delegates to the overloaded variant, passing in constructor-injected NavigationHandler as argument.
items.translation: 此标准 JSF `handleNavigation` 方法的实现委托给重载版本，并将构造函数注入的 `NavigationHandler` 作为参数传入。

items.source: Create a DecoratingNavigationHandler without fixed original NavigationHandler.
items.translation: 创建一个不带固定原始 NavigationHandler 的 DecoratingNavigationHandler。

items.source: Create a DecoratingNavigationHandler with fixed original NavigationHandler.
items.translation: 创建一个具有固定原始 NavigationHandler 的 DecoratingNavigationHandler。

items.source:
Return the fixed original NavigationHandler decorated by this handler, if any
(that is, if passed in through the constructor).
items.translation: 如果存在由该处理器装饰的原始 NavigationHandler（即通过构造函数传入），则返回它。
facesContext - 当前的 JSF 上下文

items.source: Special handleNavigation variant with explicit NavigationHandler argument.
items.translation: 带有显式 NavigationHandler 参数的特殊handleNavigation变体。

items.source:
Method to be called by subclasses when intending to delegate to the next
handler in the NavigationHandler chain.
items.translation: 子类在打算委托到 NavigationHandler 链中的下一个处理器时，应调用的方法。
